headline: Ep Biocomposites wins Rs 0.92 Cr STP order from Beleza by the Beach
summary: Ep Biocomposites secures Rs 0.92 crore work order for a 70 KLD Sewage Treatment Plant. The order represents significant backlog addition for the SME utility player.

headline: Beezaasan board to decide on Asawara acquisition
summary: Beezaasan Explotech Ltd board meeting on Sep 30, 2026, will consider acquiring equity shares of associate company Asawara Earthtech Limited.

headline: TGV Sraac shareholders approve MoA object clause change
summary: TGV Sraac Limited shareholders approved alterations to the Memorandum of Association during the AGM held on September 26, 2026. The changes expand business scope to include infrastructure development and real estate.

headline: Kilburn Office Automation posts FY26 loss
summary: Kilburn Office Automation Limited reported a net loss of ₹30.95 lakh in FY26, driven by deferred tax charges and administrative expenses. The company remains non-operational post-CIRP.

headline: Zee Learn faces NCLT petition for ₹821 crore default
summary: ACRE has filed a petition seeking CIRP initiation against Zee Learn and its subsidiary DVPL for an alleged default of approximately ₹821 crore.

headline: Econo Trade closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Econo Trade India Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after declaring Q2FY27 results to comply with insider trading norms.

headline: Brilliant Portfolios AGM concludes; all resolutions passed
summary: Brilliant Portfolios Limited held its 32nd AGM via video conferencing on September 27, 2026. All ordinary and special resolutions, including director re-appointments and remuneration approvals, were passed with requisite majority.

headline: Alldigi Tech to host investor call Sep 30
summary: Alldigi Tech Limited will participate in the Bharat Connect Conference on September 30, 2026. The virtual group meeting is scheduled for 2:00 pm IST.

headline: Vrundavan Plantation closes trading window for Q2FY27 results
summary: Vrundavan Plantation Ltd has closed its trading window from October 1, 2026, until 48 hours after announcing Q2FY27 financial results.

headline: My Money Securities approves auditor re-appointment
summary: My Money Securities Ltd approved the re-appointment of Sharma Goel & Co. LLP as statutory auditors and authorized the acquisition of up to 100% equity in My Money Credits Private Limited.

headline: Raghav Productivity Enhancers hosts White Oak plant visit
summary: Raghav Productivity Enhancers Limited will host a plant visit for White Oak Capital Management at its Newai facility on September 30, 2026. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be shared.

headline: Techknowgreen AGM adopts FY26 financials
summary: Techknowgreen Solutions held its 4th AGM on September 27, 2026. Members adopted FY26 financial statements and reappointed Prasad Rangrao Pawar as Director.

headline: Rainbow Denim appoints K K Sinha as cost auditor
summary: Rainbow Denim Limited appointed M/s K K Sinha & Associates as Cost Auditor for FY27 under Section 148 of the Companies Act, following NCLT approval.

headline: Surya India Ltd holds 41st AGM, approves related party loans
summary: Surya India Limited concluded its 41st AGM on September 27, 2026. The meeting approved material related party transactions and loans to Haldiram group entities under Section 185.

headline: Canara Bank pays ₹377 crore annual interest on NCDs
summary: Canara Bank confirmed the timely payment of ₹377 crore in annual interest on its non-convertible debentures. The payout was credited to bondholders on September 27, 2026.

headline: NMDC commissions ₹5,427 crore integrated iron ore project
summary: NMDC commissioned a ₹5,427 crore integrated project in Chhattisgarh, featuring a 15 MTPA slurry pipeline and 2 MTPA pellet plant, enhancing its iron ore value chain.

headline: Aerpace Industries allots warrants to promoter trust
summary: Aerpace Industries allotted 1.5 crore warrants at ₹32.55 each to N.K. Family Private Trust, raising ₹48.82 crore via preferential issue.

headline: Bits Ltd holds 34th AGM via video conferencing
summary: Bits Limited conducted its 34th Annual General Meeting on September 27, 2026, via video conferencing. Key agenda items included adopting FY26 financial statements and appointing new statutory auditors.

headline: Pan India Corporation holds 42nd AGM via video conferencing
summary: Pan India Corporation Limited conducted its 42nd AGM on September 27, 2026, adopting FY26 financials and appointing new statutory auditors.

headline: Virat Industries PAT jumps 446% in FY26
summary: Virat Industries reported a net profit of ₹49.39 lakh for FY26, up 446% YoY. Revenue from operations declined 15.3% to ₹26.79 crore amid lower export volumes.

headline: HP Adhesives faces customs penalty of ₹28.71 lakh
summary: HP Adhesives received a customs order imposing a penalty of ₹28.71 lakh and redemption fine of ₹8.50 lakh for anti-dumping duty violations on PTFE imports.

headline: Desh Rakshak closes trading window for Q2FY27
summary: Desh Rakshak Aushdhalaya Ltd closes its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of Q2FY27 results. Insiders barred from trading until 48 hours post-declaration.

headline: Chennai Ferrous closes trading window from Oct 1
summary: Chennai Ferrous Industries closes its trading window from October 1, 2026, ahead of the Q2FY27 board meeting. Insider trading restrictions apply until 48 hours post-approval.

headline: Goodluck India sub raises ₹276 Cr for capacity
summary: Goodluck Defence and Aerospace raised ₹276 crore via preferential issue to scale artillery shell production to 4 lakh units annually. Goodluck India retains 69.08% stake post-issue.

headline: Semac Construction AGM approves all six resolutions
summary: Semac Construction Limited passed all six resolutions at its 49th AGM, including financial statement adoption and director re-appointments. Related party transactions saw 78.71% approval.

headline: Kaiser Corporation reports nil complaints on Emazing merger
summary: Kaiser Corporation Limited reported receiving zero complaints regarding its proposed scheme of amalgamation with Emazing Deals Limited. The compliance report was submitted to BSE following the expiry of the public objection period.

headline: Airfloa Rail Technology secures Rs 7.33 crore order from Acme India
summary: Airfloa Rail Technology disclosed a Rs 7.33 crore order from Acme India Industries Ltd for supply of specified items. The contract, dated September 26, 2026, requires completion by October 27, 2026.
